data.priceDefinition: USD price as of end of each labeled UTC day; not intraday high or spot quote

evaluationRules.priceDefinition: Coin Metrics PriceUSD UTC daily end-of-day observations; intraday exchange highs and self-reported execution prices are different measurements.
evaluationRules.safetyOfClaims: These are empirical comparisons and conditional scenarios, not mathematical proof of future prices.
evaluationRules.noAggregateAccuracyRate: Selected publications are not a complete pre-registered population; many repeat the same thesis. Ambiguous, qualitative and unexpired forecasts are not forced into win/loss scores.
evaluationRules.versioning: Keep each publication date, window and target immutable; a revised window does not overwrite the original.
evaluationRules.highZoneLookAhead: A threshold defined against the eventual peak uses future information and is retrospective only.
evaluationRules.originalXTimestampInference: When used: timestamp_ms=(int(status_id)>>22)+1288834974657. This identifies status creation time, not text edit history.
